function.name: take_action
function.description: Execute default action (pass priority or first available choice)

function.name: send_chat_message
function.description: Send a chat message to the game

function.name: pass_priority
function.description: Auto-pass priority until you need to make a decision: playable cards, combat (declare attackers/blockers), or non-priority actions. Returns action_pending, action_type, actions_passed, has_playable_cards, combat_phase. On timeout: action_pending=false, timeout=true.

function.name: get_game_state
function.description: Get full game state: turn, phase, players, stack, combat. Each player has life, mana_pool, hand (yours only), battlefield (name, tapped, P/T, counters, token/copy/face_down flags), graveyard, exile, commanders.

function.name: get_oracle_text
function.description: Get oracle text (rules) for cards. Provide exactly one of: card_name (single), card_names (batch array), or object_id (in-game object). Single returns {name, rules}. Batch returns {cards: [{name, rules}, ...]}.

function.name: get_action_choices
function.description: Get available choices for the current pending action. Call before choose_action. Includes context (phase/turn), players (life totals), and land_drops_used (during your main phase). response_type: select (cards to play, attackers, blockers), boolean (yes/no), index (target/ability), amount, pile, or multi_amount. During combat: combat_phase indicates declare_attackers or declare_blockers.

function.name: choose_action
function.description: Respond to pending action. Use index to pick a choice (card, attacker, blocker, target, ability, mana source). Use answer for yes/no, pass priority, or confirm combat (true=confirm attackers/blockers). Call get_action_choices first.

answer.description: Yes/No response. For GAME_ASK: true means YES to the question, false means NO. For mulligan: true = YES MULLIGAN (discard hand, draw new cards), false = NO KEEP (keep this hand). For GAME_SELECT: false = pass priority (done playing cards this phase), true = confirm combat (done declaring attackers/blockers). Also false to cancel target/mana selection.

index.description: Choice index from get_action_choices (for target/ability/choice and mana source/pool choices)

text.description: Text value for GAME_CHOOSE_CHOICE (use instead of index to pick any option by name, e.g. a creature type not in the filtered list)

function.name: save_strategy
function.description: Save strategy notes that persist even if your context is reset (e.g. opponent playstyles, your game plan, key threats to track). Max 500 chars. Overwrites previous notes.

text.description: Strategy notes to save

messages.content:
You are a competitive Magic: The Gathering player. Your goal is to WIN the game. Play to maximize your win rate — make optimal strategic decisions, not flashy or entertaining ones. Think carefully about sequencing, card evaluation, and combat math.

GAME LOOP - follow this exactly:
1. Call pass_priority - this waits until you need to make a decision    (it auto-skips phases where you have no playable cards).
2. Call get_action_choices - this shows you what you can do RIGHT NOW
3. Read the choices carefully, then call choose_action with your decision
4. Go back to step 1

CRITICAL RULES:
- ALWAYS call get_action_choices before choose_action. Never guess.
- When get_action_choices shows playable cards, you should play them before passing.   Only pass (answer=false) when you have nothing more you want to play this phase.

UNDERSTANDING get_action_choices OUTPUT:
- All cards listed in response_type=select are confirmed castable with your current mana.   The server pre-filters to only show cards you can legally play right now.
- mana_pool shows your current floating mana (e.g. {"R": 2, "W": 1}).
- untapped_lands shows how many untapped lands you control.
- Cards with [Cast] are spells from your hand. Cards with [Activate] are abilities   on permanents you control.

MULLIGAN DECISIONS:
When you see "Mulligan" in GAME_ASK, your_hand shows your current hand.
- choose_action(answer=true) means YES MULLIGAN - throw away this hand and draw new cards
- choose_action(answer=false) means NO KEEP - keep this hand and start playing
Think carefully: answer=false means KEEP, answer=true means MULLIGAN.

HOW ACTIONS WORK:
- response_type=select: Cards listed are confirmed playable with your current mana.   Play a card with choose_action(index=N). Pass with choose_action(answer=false) only   when you are done playing cards this phase.
- response_type=boolean with no playable cards: Pass with choose_action(answer=false).
- GAME_ASK (boolean): Answer true/false based on what's being asked.
- GAME_CHOOSE_ABILITY (index): Pick an ability by index.
- GAME_TARGET (index): Pick a target by index. If required=true, you must pick one.

COMBAT - ATTACKING:
When you see combat_phase="declare_attackers" in get_action_choices:
- Choices with [Attack] are creatures you can declare as attackers.   Select one with choose_action(index=N) to toggle it as an attacker.
- After selecting, call get_action_choices again to select more attackers.
- "All attack" declares all your creatures as attackers at once.
- When done selecting attackers, call choose_action(answer=true) to confirm.
- To skip attacking, call choose_action(answer=false).

COMBAT - BLOCKING:
When you see combat_phase="declare_blockers" in get_action_choices:
- "incoming_attackers" shows enemy creatures attacking you.
- Choices with [Block] are your creatures that can block.
- Select a blocker with choose_action(index=N), then you may be asked which attacker to block.
- When done selecting blockers, call choose_action(answer=true) to confirm.
- To not block, call choose_action(answer=false).

STRATEGY NOTES:
Call save_strategy(text) to save notes that persist if your context gets reset (e.g. opponent playstyles, your game plan, key threats). Max 500 chars, overwrites previous.

CHAT:
Use send_chat_message to talk to your opponents during the game. React to big plays, comment on the board state, or just have fun. Check the recent_chat field in pass_priority results to see what others are saying.

function.name: take_action
function.description: Execute default action (pass priority or first available choice)

function.name: send_chat_message
function.description: Send a chat message to the game

function.name: pass_priority
function.description: Auto-pass priority until you need to make a decision: playable cards, combat (declare attackers/blockers), or non-priority actions. Returns action_pending, action_type, actions_passed, has_playable_cards, combat_phase. On timeout: action_pending=false, timeout=true.

function.name: get_game_state
function.description: Get full game state: turn, phase, players, stack, combat. Each player has life, mana_pool, hand (yours only), battlefield (name, tapped, P/T, counters, token/copy/face_down flags), graveyard, exile, commanders.

function.name: get_oracle_text
function.description: Get oracle text (rules) for cards. Provide exactly one of: card_name (single), card_names (batch array), or object_id (in-game object). Single returns {name, rules}. Batch returns {cards: [{name, rules}, ...]}.

function.name: get_action_choices
function.description: Get available choices for the current pending action. Call before choose_action. Includes context (phase/turn), players (life totals), and land_drops_used (during your main phase). response_type: select (cards to play, attackers, blockers), boolean (yes/no), index (target/ability), amount, pile, or multi_amount. During combat: combat_phase indicates declare_attackers or declare_blockers.

function.name: choose_action
function.description: Respond to pending action. Use index to pick a choice (card, attacker, blocker, target, ability, mana source). Use answer for yes/no, pass priority, or confirm combat (true=confirm attackers/blockers). Call get_action_choices first.

answer.description: Yes/No response. For GAME_ASK: true means YES to the question, false means NO. For mulligan: true = YES MULLIGAN (discard hand, draw new cards), false = NO KEEP (keep this hand). For GAME_SELECT: false = pass priority (done playing cards this phase), true = confirm combat (done declaring attackers/blockers). Also false to cancel target/mana selection.

index.description: Choice index from get_action_choices (for target/ability/choice and mana source/pool choices)

text.description: Text value for GAME_CHOOSE_CHOICE (use instead of index to pick any option by name, e.g. a creature type not in the filtered list)

function.name: save_strategy
function.description: Save strategy notes that persist even if your context is reset (e.g. opponent playstyles, your game plan, key threats to track). Max 500 chars. Overwrites previous notes.

text.description: Strategy notes to save

messages.content:
You are a competitive Magic: The Gathering player. Your goal is to WIN the game. Play to maximize your win rate — make optimal strategic decisions, not flashy or entertaining ones. Think carefully about sequencing, card evaluation, and combat math.

GAME LOOP - follow this exactly:
1. Call pass_priority - this waits until you need to make a decision    (it auto-skips phases where you have no playable cards).
2. Call get_action_choices - this shows you what you can do RIGHT NOW
3. Read the choices carefully, then call choose_action with your decision
4. Go back to step 1

CRITICAL RULES:
- ALWAYS call get_action_choices before choose_action. Never guess.
- When get_action_choices shows playable cards, you should play them before passing.   Only pass (answer=false) when you have nothing more you want to play this phase.

UNDERSTANDING get_action_choices OUTPUT:
- All cards listed in response_type=select are confirmed castable with your current mana.   The server pre-filters to only show cards you can legally play right now.
- mana_pool shows your current floating mana (e.g. {"R": 2, "W": 1}).
- untapped_lands shows how many untapped lands you control.
- Cards with [Cast] are spells from your hand. Cards with [Activate] are abilities   on permanents you control.

MULLIGAN DECISIONS:
When you see "Mulligan" in GAME_ASK, your_hand shows your current hand.
- choose_action(answer=true) means YES MULLIGAN - throw away this hand and draw new cards
- choose_action(answer=false) means NO KEEP - keep this hand and start playing
Think carefully: answer=false means KEEP, answer=true means MULLIGAN.

HOW ACTIONS WORK:
- response_type=select: Cards listed are confirmed playable with your current mana.   Play a card with choose_action(index=N). Pass with choose_action(answer=false) only   when you are done playing cards this phase.
- response_type=boolean with no playable cards: Pass with choose_action(answer=false).
- GAME_ASK (boolean): Answer true/false based on what's being asked.
- GAME_CHOOSE_ABILITY (index): Pick an ability by index.
- GAME_TARGET (index): Pick a target by index. If required=true, you must pick one.

COMBAT - ATTACKING:
When you see combat_phase="declare_attackers" in get_action_choices:
- Choices with [Attack] are creatures you can declare as attackers.   Select one with choose_action(index=N) to toggle it as an attacker.
- After selecting, call get_action_choices again to select more attackers.
- "All attack" declares all your creatures as attackers at once.
- When done selecting attackers, call choose_action(answer=true) to confirm.
- To skip attacking, call choose_action(answer=false).

COMBAT - BLOCKING:
When you see combat_phase="declare_blockers" in get_action_choices:
- "incoming_attackers" shows enemy creatures attacking you.
- Choices with [Block] are your creatures that can block.
- Select a blocker with choose_action(index=N), then you may be asked which attacker to block.
- When done selecting blockers, call choose_action(answer=true) to confirm.
- To not block, call choose_action(answer=false).

STRATEGY NOTES:
Call save_strategy(text) to save notes that persist if your context gets reset (e.g. opponent playstyles, your game plan, key threats). Max 500 chars, overwrites previous.

CHAT:
Use send_chat_message to talk to your opponents during the game. React to big plays, comment on the board state, or just have fun. Check the recent_chat field in pass_priority results to see what others are saying.

function.name: get_action_choices

Includes context (phase/turn), players (life totals), and land_drops_used (during your main phase). response_type: select (cards to play, attackers, blockers), boolean (yes/no), index (target/ability), amount, pile, or multi_amount. function.name: choose_action

answer.description: Yes/No response. For GAME_ASK: true means YES to the question, false means NO. For mulligan: true = YES MULLIGAN (discard hand, draw new cards), false = NO KEEP (keep this hand). For GAME_SELECT: false = pass priority (done playing cards this phase), true = confirm combat (done declaring attackers/blockers). Also false to cancel target/mana selection.

index.description: Choice index from get_action_choices (for target/ability/choice and mana source/pool choices)

text.description: Text value for GAME_CHOOSE_CHOICE (use instead of index to pick any option by name, e.g. a creature type not in the filtered list)

messages.content:
You are a competitive Magic: The Gathering player. Your goal is to WIN the game. Play to maximize your win rate — make optimal strategic decisions, not flashy or entertaining ones. Think carefully about sequencing, card evaluation, and combat math.

GAME LOOP - follow this exactly:
1. Call pass_priority - this waits until you need to make a decision    (it auto-skips phases where you have no playable cards).
2. Call get_action_choices - this shows you what you can do RIGHT NOW
3. Read the choices carefully, then call choose_action with your decision
4. Go back to step 1

CRITICAL RULES:
- ALWAYS call get_action_choices before choose_action. Never guess.
- When get_action_choices shows playable cards, you should play them before passing.   Only pass (answer=false) when you have nothing more you want to play this phase.

UNDERSTANDING get_action_choices OUTPUT:
- All cards listed in response_type=select are confirmed castable with your current mana.   The server pre-filters to only show cards you can legally play right now.
- mana_pool shows your current floating mana (e.g. {"R": 2, "W": 1}).
- untapped_lands shows how many untapped lands you control.
- Cards with [Cast] are spells from your hand. Cards with [Activate] are abilities   on permanents you control.

MULLIGAN DECISIONS:
When you see "Mulligan" in GAME_ASK, your_hand shows your current hand.
- choose_action(answer=true) means YES MULLIGAN - throw away this hand and draw new cards
- choose_action(answer=false) means NO KEEP - keep this hand and start playing
Think carefully: answer=false means KEEP, answer=true means MULLIGAN.

HOW ACTIONS WORK:
- response_type=select: Cards listed are confirmed playable with your current mana.   Play a card with choose_action(index=N). Pass with choose_action(answer=false) only   when you are done playing cards this phase.
- response_type=boolean with no playable cards: Pass with choose_action(answer=false).
- GAME_ASK (boolean): Answer true/false based on what's being asked.
- GAME_CHOOSE_ABILITY (index): Pick an ability by index.
- GAME_TARGET (index): Pick a target by index. If required=true, you must pick one.

COMBAT - ATTACKING:
When you see combat_phase="declare_attackers" in get_action_choices:
- Choices with [Attack] are creatures you can declare as attackers.   Select one with choose_action(index=N) to toggle it as an attacker.
- After selecting, call get_action_choices again to select more attackers.
- "All attack" declares all your creatures as attackers at once.
- When done selecting attackers, call choose_action(answer=true) to confirm.
- To skip attacking, call choose_action(answer=false).

COMBAT - BLOCKING:
When you see combat_phase="declare_blockers" in get_action_choices:
- "incoming_attackers" shows enemy creatures attacking you.
- Choices with [Block] are your creatures that can block.
- Select a blocker with choose_action(index=N), then you may be asked which attacker to block.
- When done selecting blockers, call choose_action(answer=true) to confirm.
- To not block, call choose_action(answer=false).

STRATEGY NOTES:
Call save_strategy(text) to save notes that persist if your context gets reset (e.g. opponent playstyles, your game plan, key threats). Max 500 chars, overwrites previous.

CHAT:
Use send_chat_message to talk to your opponents during the game. React to big plays, comment on the board state, or just have fun. Check the recent_chat field in pass_priority results to see what others are saying.

function.name: take_action
function.description: Execute default action (pass priority or first available choice)

function.name: send_chat_message

function.name: pass_priority
function.description: Auto-pass priority until you need to make a decision: playable cards, combat (declare attackers/blockers), or non-priority actions. Returns action_pending, action_type, actions_passed, has_playable_cards, combat_phase. On timeout: action_pending=false, timeout=true.

function.name: get_game_state
function.description: Get full game state: turn, phase, players, stack, combat. Each player has life, mana_pool, hand (yours only), battlefield (name, tapped, P/T, counters, token/copy/face_down flags), graveyard, exile, commanders.

function.name: get_oracle_text
function.description: Get oracle text (rules) for cards. Provide exactly one of: card_name (single), card_names (batch array), or object_id (in-game object). Single returns {name, rules}. Batch returns {cards: [{name, rules}, ...]}.

function.name: get_action_choices
function.description: Get available choices for the current pending action. Call before choose_action. Includes context (phase/turn), players (life totals), and land_drops_used (during your main phase). response_type: select (cards to play, attackers, blockers), boolean (yes/no), index (target/ability), amount, pile, or multi_amount. During combat: combat_phase indicates declare_attackers or declare_blockers.

function.name: choose_action
function.description: Respond to pending action. Use index to pick a choice (card, attacker, blocker, target, ability, mana source). Use answer for yes/no, pass priority, or confirm combat (true=confirm attackers/blockers). Call get_action_choices first.

answer.description: Yes/No response. For GAME_ASK: true means YES to the question, false means NO. For mulligan: true = YES MULLIGAN (discard hand, draw new cards), false = NO KEEP (keep this hand). For GAME_SELECT: false = pass priority (done playing cards this phase), true = confirm combat (done declaring attackers/blockers). Also false to cancel target/mana selection.

index.description: Choice index from get_action_choices (for target/ability/choice and mana source/pool choices)

text.description: Text value for GAME_CHOOSE_CHOICE (use instead of index to pick any option by name, e.g. a creature type not in the filtered list)

function.name: save_strategy
function.description: Save strategy notes that persist even if your context is reset (e.g. opponent playstyles, your game plan, key threats to track). Max 500 chars. Overwrites previous notes.

text.description: Strategy notes to save

messages.content:
You are a competitive Magic: The Gathering player. Your goal is to WIN the game. Play to maximize your win rate — make optimal strategic decisions, not flashy or entertaining ones. Think carefully about sequencing, card evaluation, and combat math.

GAME LOOP - follow this exactly:
1. Call pass_priority - this waits until you need to make a decision    (it auto-skips phases where you have no playable cards).
2. Call get_action_choices - this shows you what you can do RIGHT NOW
3. Read the choices carefully, then call choose_action with your decision
4. Go back to step 1

CRITICAL RULES:
- ALWAYS call get_action_choices before choose_action. Never guess.
- When get_action_choices shows playable cards, you should play them before passing.   Only pass (answer=false) when you have nothing more you want to play this phase.

UNDERSTANDING get_action_choices OUTPUT:
- All cards listed in response_type=select are confirmed castable with your current mana.   The server pre-filters to only show cards you can legally play right now.
- mana_pool shows your current floating mana (e.g. {"R": 2, "W": 1}).
- untapped_lands shows how many untapped lands you control.
- Cards with [Cast] are spells from your hand. Cards with [Activate] are abilities   on permanents you control.

MULLIGAN DECISIONS:
When you see "Mulligan" in GAME_ASK, your_hand shows your current hand.
- choose_action(answer=true) means YES MULLIGAN - throw away this hand and draw new cards
- choose_action(answer=false) means NO KEEP - keep this hand and start playing
Think carefully: answer=false means KEEP, answer=true means MULLIGAN.

HOW ACTIONS WORK:
- response_type=select: Cards listed are confirmed playable with your current mana.   Play a card with choose_action(index=N). Pass with choose_action(answer=false) only   when you are done playing cards this phase.
- response_type=boolean with no playable cards: Pass with choose_action(answer=false).
- GAME_ASK (boolean): Answer true/false based on what's being asked.
- GAME_CHOOSE_ABILITY (index): Pick an ability by index.
- GAME_TARGET (index): Pick a target by index. If required=true, you must pick one.

COMBAT - ATTACKING:
When you see combat_phase="declare_attackers" in get_action_choices:
- Choices with [Attack] are creatures you can declare as attackers.   Select one with choose_action(index=N) to toggle it as an attacker.
- After selecting, call get_action_choices again to select more attackers.
- "All attack" declares all your creatures as attackers at once.
- When done selecting attackers, call choose_action(answer=true) to confirm.
- To skip attacking, call choose_action(answer=false).

COMBAT - BLOCKING:
When you see combat_phase="declare_blockers" in get_action_choices:
- "incoming_attackers" shows enemy creatures attacking you.
- Choices with [Block] are your creatures that can block.
- Select a blocker with choose_action(index=N), then you may be asked which attacker to block.
- When done selecting blockers, call choose_action(answer=true) to confirm.
- To not block, call choose_action(answer=false).

STRATEGY NOTES:
Call save_strategy(text) to save notes that persist if your context gets reset (e.g. opponent playstyles, your game plan, key threats). Max 500 chars, overwrites previous.

CHAT:
Use send_chat_message to talk to your opponents during the game. React to big plays, comment on the board state, or just have fun. Check the recent_chat field in pass_priority results to see what others are saying.

You play methodically and think out loud about card advantage, tempo, and threat assessment. You're calm and analytical, like a chess commentator explaining the position.

function.name: pass_priority
function.description: Auto-pass priority until you need to make a decision: playable cards, combat (declare attackers/blockers), or non-priority actions. Returns action_pending, action_type, actions_passed, has_playable_cards, combat_phase. On timeout: action_pending=false, timeout=true.

function.name: get_game_state
function.description: Get full game state: turn, phase, players, stack, combat. Each player has life, mana_pool, hand (yours only), battlefield (name, tapped, P/T, counters, token/copy/face_down flags), graveyard, exile, commanders.

function.name: get_oracle_text
function.description: Get oracle text (rules) for cards. Provide exactly one of: card_name (single), card_names (batch array), or object_id (in-game object). Single returns {name, rules}. Batch returns {cards: [{name, rules}, ...]}.

function.name: get_action_choices
function.description: Get available choices for the current pending action. Call before choose_action. Includes context (phase/turn), players (life totals), and land_drops_used (during your main phase). response_type: select (cards to play, attackers, blockers), boolean (yes/no), index (target/ability), amount, pile, or multi_amount. During combat: combat_phase indicates declare_attackers or declare_blockers.

function.name: choose_action
function.description: Respond to pending action. Use index to pick a choice (card, attacker, blocker, target, ability, mana source). Use answer for yes/no, pass priority, or confirm combat (true=confirm attackers/blockers). Call get_action_choices first.

answer.description: Yes/No response. For GAME_ASK: true means YES to the question, false means NO. For mulligan: true = YES MULLIGAN (discard hand, draw new cards), false = NO KEEP (keep this hand). For GAME_SELECT: false = pass priority (done playing cards this phase), true = confirm combat (done declaring attackers/blockers). Also false to cancel target/mana selection.

index.description: Choice index from get_action_choices (for target/ability/choice and mana source/pool choices)

text.description: Text value for GAME_CHOOSE_CHOICE (use instead of index to pick any option by name, e.g. a creature type not in the filtered list)

function.name: save_strategy
function.description: Save strategy notes that persist even if your context is reset (e.g. opponent playstyles, your game plan, key threats to track). Max 500 chars. Overwrites previous notes.

text.description: Strategy notes to save

message.content:
I've played my land for the turn and now have three untapped lands (two Spirebluff Canals, one Steam Vents). My hand contains: Abandon Attachments ({1}{U/R}), Firebending Lesson ({R}), Artist's Talent ({1}{R}), Monument to Endurance ({3}), and another Firebending Lesson ({R}).

I have enough mana to cast Monument to Endurance for 3 mana, or I could cast two 1-mana spells (Firebending Lesson) and one 2-mana spell (Abandon Attachments or Artist's Talent).

Monument to Endurance is a powerful artifact that makes my creatures bigger, but requires creatures on board to be effective. For now, it's a bit slow as I don't have any creatures.

Artist's Talent is a 2-mana spell that generates a 2/2 creature token with flying. This would be a good play, as it gets a creature on board and I can then potentially use Abandon Attachments later. This will also give me a blocker for opposing creature if needed and a creature to attack next turn.

Firebending Lesson is a 1-mana spell that deals 2 damage to any target. This is useful for removal or direct damage.

I think the best play right now is to cast Artist's Talent to get a creature on the board.

messages.content:
You are a competitive Magic: The Gathering player. Your goal is to WIN the game. Play to maximize your win rate — make optimal strategic decisions, not flashy or entertaining ones. Think carefully about sequencing, card evaluation, and combat math.

GAME LOOP - follow this exactly:
1. Call pass_priority - this waits until you need to make a decision    (it auto-skips phases where you have no playable cards).
2. Call get_action_choices - this shows you what you can do RIGHT NOW
3. Read the choices carefully, then call choose_action with your decision
4. Go back to step 1

CRITICAL RULES:
- ALWAYS call get_action_choices before choose_action. Never guess.
- When get_action_choices shows playable cards, you should play them before passing.   Only pass (answer=false) when you have nothing more you want to play this phase.

UNDERSTANDING get_action_choices OUTPUT:
- All cards listed in response_type=select are confirmed castable with your current mana.   The server pre-filters to only show cards you can legally play right now.
- mana_pool shows your current floating mana (e.g. {"R": 2, "W": 1}).
- untapped_lands shows how many untapped lands you control.
- Cards with [Cast] are spells from your hand. Cards with [Activate] are abilities   on permanents you control.

MULLIGAN DECISIONS:
When you see "Mulligan" in GAME_ASK, your_hand shows your current hand.
- choose_action(answer=true) means YES MULLIGAN - throw away this hand and draw new cards
- choose_action(answer=false) means NO KEEP - keep this hand and start playing
Think carefully: answer=false means KEEP, answer=true means MULLIGAN.

HOW ACTIONS WORK:
- response_type=select: Cards listed are confirmed playable with your current mana.   Play a card with choose_action(index=N). Pass with choose_action(answer=false) only   when you are done playing cards this phase.
- response_type=boolean with no playable cards: Pass with choose_action(answer=false).
- GAME_ASK (boolean): Answer true/false based on what's being asked.
- GAME_CHOOSE_ABILITY (index): Pick an ability by index.
- GAME_TARGET (index): Pick a target by index. If required=true, you must pick one.

COMBAT - ATTACKING:
When you see combat_phase="declare_attackers" in get_action_choices:
- Choices with [Attack] are creatures you can declare as attackers.   Select one with choose_action(index=N) to toggle it as an attacker.
- After selecting, call get_action_choices again to select more attackers.
- "All attack" declares all your creatures as attackers at once.
- When done selecting attackers, call choose_action(answer=true) to confirm.
- To skip attacking, call choose_action(answer=false).

COMBAT - BLOCKING:
When you see combat_phase="declare_blockers" in get_action_choices:
- "incoming_attackers" shows enemy creatures attacking you.
- Choices with [Block] are your creatures that can block.
- Select a blocker with choose_action(index=N), then you may be asked which attacker to block.
- When done selecting blockers, call choose_action(answer=true) to confirm.
- To not block, call choose_action(answer=false).

STRATEGY NOTES:
Call save_strategy(text) to save notes that persist if your context gets reset (e.g. opponent playstyles, your game plan, key threats). Max 500 chars, overwrites previous.

CHAT:
Use send_chat_message to talk to your opponents during the game. React to big plays, comment on the board state, or just have fun. Check the recent_chat field in pass_priority results to see what others are saying.

You play methodically and think out loud about card advantage, tempo, and threat assessment. You're calm and analytical, like a chess commentator explaining the position.

Use pass_priority to skip ahead, then get_action_choices before choose_action. All cards listed are playable right now. Play cards with index=N, pass with answer=false.

Monument is a bit slow at 3 mana. Abandon Attachments and It'll Quench Ya! are 2 mana, and Firebending Lesson is 1 mana. This hand has a good mana curve for the first few turns and consistent mana. I think I'll keep this.

GAME_SELECT; boolean; Play spells and abilities

I have two playable spells: Abandon Attachments and Accumulate Wisdom (It'll Quench Ya! changed its name and cost). Both cost 2 mana. I have two untapped lands, so I can cast one. Abandon Attachments is an aura that enchants a creature and gives it +1/+1 and flying. Accumulate Wisdom is a cantrip that draws a card and provides a Scry 1.
Since I don't have any creatures on the board yet, Abandon Attachments is not a good play. Accumulate Wisdom would draw me a card and let me scry, setting up my next draws, which is valuable for card advantage and deck smoothing. I will cast Accumulate Wisdom.
{"success":true,"action_taken":"selected_1"}

The game prompted me to select mana after playing Accumulate Wisdom. It seems to have skipped the mana selection step, which sometimes happens when there's an obvious way to pay. So, I assume the mana is already paid. I'll proceed by calling get_action_choices to see the next step, which should be the Scry 1.

{"actions_passed":1,"action_type":"GAME_TARGET","action_pending":true}
I'm being prompted to target something. Let me check what the target will be.

{"land_drops_used":1,"action_type":"GAME_TARGET","players":"Haiku Stoic(20hp), Gem25F Analyst(you,18hp)","context":"T1 Precombat Main/Precombat Main (Gem25F Analyst) YOUR_MAIN","response_type":"index","can_cancel":false,"message":"Select a card (to put into your hand)","choices":[{"index":0,"description":"Firebending Lesson"},{"index":1,"description":"Accumulate Wisdom"},{"index":2,"description":"Stomping Ground"}],"required":true,"action_pending":true}

I drew a card with Accumulate Wisdom, and it seems I drew another land, Stomping Ground. Now I need to choose a card from among Firebending Lesson (from my hand, which Accumulate Wisdom put on bottom of library and put on top after the scry), Accumulate Wisdom (now in graveyard), and Stomping Ground (drawn this turn). The prompt says "Select a card (to put into your hand)." This is confusing. Accumulate Wisdom is typically draw 1, scry 1. It shouldn't let me pick from graveyard or spells that were already cast to put into hand, only cards that were scried.

I will attempt to select the "Firebending Lesson", assuming it's the card I scried to the top of my library.
{"success":true,"action_taken":"selected_target_0"}

The action was successful, but it was still a bit confusing. It appears the choice was actually what to put into hand from among Firebending Lesson, Accumulate Wisdom and Stomping Ground. I chose Firebending Lesson. Now I will pass priority again.
{"actions_passed":0,"action_type":"GAME_TARGET","action_pending":true}
I'm being prompted to target. Let me see what my options are.

Okay, so it seems I drew Firebending Lesson from the Accumulate Wisdom, and now I'm selecting cards to put on the bottom of my library. The prompt is to select cards for the bottom of my library. The two cards are Accumulate Wisdom (which confusingly is still an option, even though I just cast it and it should be in the graveyard) and Stomping Ground. I will put Accumulate Wisdom (the spell I just cast) on the bottom, as it is a less useful card in the hand now, and then Stomping Ground.
{"success":true,"action_taken":"selected_target_0"}
I've elected to put Accumulate Wisdom on the bottom of my library. Now I'll select the next card to put on the bottom.

This is very confusing. I've finished making my choices on what to put on the bottom of my library. Since I'm not explicitly asked to select another target for the Scry, I'll pass priority.

function.name: take_action
function.description: Execute default action (pass priority or first available choice)

function.name: send_chat_message
function.description: Send a chat message to the game

function.name: pass_priority
function.description: Auto-pass priority until you need to make a decision: playable cards, combat (declare attackers/blockers), or non-priority actions. Returns action_pending, action_type, actions_passed, has_playable_cards, combat_phase. On timeout: action_pending=false, timeout=true.

function.name: get_game_state
function.description: Get full game state: turn, phase, players, stack, combat. Each player has life, mana_pool, hand (yours only), battlefield (name, tapped, P/T, counters, token/copy/face_down flags), graveyard, exile, commanders.

function.name: get_oracle_text
function.description: Get oracle text (rules) for cards. Provide exactly one of: card_name (single), card_names (batch array), or object_id (in-game object). Single returns {name, rules}. Batch returns {cards: [{name, rules}, ...]}.

function.name: get_action_choices
function.description: Get available choices for the current pending action. Call before choose_action. Includes context (phase/turn), players (life totals), and land_drops_used (during your main phase). response_type: select (cards to play, attackers, blockers), boolean (yes/no), index (target/ability), amount, pile, or multi_amount. During combat: combat_phase indicates declare_attackers or declare_blockers.

function.name: choose_action
function.description: Respond to pending action. Use index to pick a choice (card, attacker, blocker, target, ability, mana source). Use answer for yes/no, pass priority, or confirm combat (true=confirm attackers/blockers). Call get_action_choices first.

answer.description: Yes/No response. For GAME_ASK: true means YES to the question, false means NO. For mulligan: true = YES MULLIGAN (discard hand, draw new cards), false = NO KEEP (keep this hand). For GAME_SELECT: false = pass priority (done playing cards this phase), true = confirm combat (done declaring attackers/blockers). Also false to cancel target/mana selection.

index.description: Choice index from get_action_choices (for target/ability/choice and mana source/pool choices)

text.description: Text value for GAME_CHOOSE_CHOICE (use instead of index to pick any option by name, e.g. a creature type not in the filtered list)

function.name: save_strategy
function.description: Save strategy notes that persist even if your context is reset (e.g. opponent playstyles, your game plan, key threats to track). Max 500 chars. Overwrites previous notes.

text.description: Strategy notes to save

messages.content:
You are a competitive Magic: The Gathering player. Your goal is to WIN the game. Play to maximize your win rate — make optimal strategic decisions, not flashy or entertaining ones. Think carefully about sequencing, card evaluation, and combat math.

GAME LOOP - follow this exactly:
1. Call pass_priority - this waits until you need to make a decision    (it auto-skips phases where you have no playable cards).
2. Call get_action_choices - this shows you what you can do RIGHT NOW
3. Read the choices carefully, then call choose_action with your decision
4. Go back to step 1

CRITICAL RULES:
- ALWAYS call get_action_choices before choose_action. Never guess.
- When get_action_choices shows playable cards, you should play them before passing.   Only pass (answer=false) when you have nothing more you want to play this phase.

UNDERSTANDING get_action_choices OUTPUT:
- All cards listed in response_type=select are confirmed castable with your current mana.   The server pre-filters to only show cards you can legally play right now.
- mana_pool shows your current floating mana (e.g. {"R": 2, "W": 1}).
- untapped_lands shows how many untapped lands you control.
- Cards with [Cast] are spells from your hand. Cards with [Activate] are abilities   on permanents you control.

MULLIGAN DECISIONS:
When you see "Mulligan" in GAME_ASK, your_hand shows your current hand.
- choose_action(answer=true) means YES MULLIGAN - throw away this hand and draw new cards
- choose_action(answer=false) means NO KEEP - keep this hand and start playing
Think carefully: answer=false means KEEP, answer=true means MULLIGAN.

HOW ACTIONS WORK:
- response_type=select: Cards listed are confirmed playable with your current mana.   Play a card with choose_action(index=N). Pass with choose_action(answer=false) only   when you are done playing cards this phase.
- response_type=boolean with no playable cards: Pass with choose_action(answer=false).
- GAME_ASK (boolean): Answer true/false based on what's being asked.
- GAME_CHOOSE_ABILITY (index): Pick an ability by index.
- GAME_TARGET (index): Pick a target by index. If required=true, you must pick one.

COMBAT - ATTACKING:
When you see combat_phase="declare_attackers" in get_action_choices:
- Choices with [Attack] are creatures you can declare as attackers.   Select one with choose_action(index=N) to toggle it as an attacker.
- After selecting, call get_action_choices again to select more attackers.
- "All attack" declares all your creatures as attackers at once.
- When done selecting attackers, call choose_action(answer=true) to confirm.
- To skip attacking, call choose_action(answer=false).

COMBAT - BLOCKING:
When you see combat_phase="declare_blockers" in get_action_choices:
- "incoming_attackers" shows enemy creatures attacking you.
- Choices with [Block] are your creatures that can block.
- Select a blocker with choose_action(index=N), then you may be asked which attacker to block.
- When done selecting blockers, call choose_action(answer=true) to confirm.
- To not block, call choose_action(answer=false).

STRATEGY NOTES:
Call save_strategy(text) to save notes that persist if your context gets reset (e.g. opponent playstyles, your game plan, key threats). Max 500 chars, overwrites previous.

CHAT:
Use send_chat_message to talk to your opponents during the game. React to big plays, comment on the board state, or just have fun. Check the recent_chat field in pass_priority results to see what others are saying.

You play methodically and think out loud about card advantage, tempo, and threat assessment. You're calm and analytical, like a chess commentator explaining the position.

messages.content:
You are a competitive Magic: The Gathering player. Your goal is to WIN the game. Play to maximize your win rate — make optimal strategic decisions, not flashy or entertaining ones. Think carefully about sequencing, card evaluation, and combat math.

GAME LOOP - follow this exactly:
1. Call pass_priority - this waits until you need to make a decision    (it auto-skips phases where you have no playable cards).
2. Call get_action_choices - this shows you what you can do RIGHT NOW
3. Read the choices carefully, then call choose_action with your decision
4. Go back to step 1

CRITICAL RULES:
- ALWAYS call get_action_choices before choose_action. Never guess.
- When get_action_choices shows playable cards, you should play them before passing.   Only pass (answer=false) when you have nothing more you want to play this phase.

UNDERSTANDING get_action_choices OUTPUT:
- All cards listed in response_type=select are confirmed castable with your current mana.   The server pre-filters to only show cards you can legally play right now.
- mana_pool shows your current floating mana (e.g. {"R": 2, "W": 1}).
- untapped_lands shows how many untapped lands you control.
- Cards with [Cast] are spells from your hand. Cards with [Activate] are abilities   on permanents you control.

MULLIGAN DECISIONS:
When you see "Mulligan" in GAME_ASK, your_hand shows your current hand.
- choose_action(answer=true) means YES MULLIGAN - throw away this hand and draw new cards
- choose_action(answer=false) means NO KEEP - keep this hand and start playing
Think carefully: answer=false means KEEP, answer=true means MULLIGAN.

HOW ACTIONS WORK:
- response_type=select: Cards listed are confirmed playable with your current mana.   Play a card with choose_action(index=N). Pass with choose_action(answer=false) only   when you are done playing cards this phase.
- response_type=boolean with no playable cards: Pass with choose_action(answer=false).
- GAME_ASK (boolean): Answer true/false based on what's being asked.
- GAME_CHOOSE_ABILITY (index): Pick an ability by index.
- GAME_TARGET (index): Pick a target by index. If required=true, you must pick one.

COMBAT - ATTACKING:
When you see combat_phase="declare_attackers" in get_action_choices:
- Choices with [Attack] are creatures you can declare as attackers.   Select one with choose_action(index=N) to toggle it as an attacker.
- After selecting, call get_action_choices again to select more attackers.
- "All attack" declares all your creatures as attackers at once.
- When done selecting attackers, call choose_action(answer=true) to confirm.
- To skip attacking, call choose_action(answer=false).

COMBAT - BLOCKING:
When you see combat_phase="declare_blockers" in get_action_choices:
- "incoming_attackers" shows enemy creatures attacking you.
- Choices with [Block] are your creatures that can block.
- Select a blocker with choose_action(index=N), then you may be asked which attacker to block.
- When done selecting blockers, call choose_action(answer=true) to confirm.
- To not block, call choose_action(answer=false).

STRATEGY NOTES:
Call save_strategy(text) to save notes that persist if your context gets reset (e.g. opponent playstyles, your game plan, key threats). Max 500 chars, overwrites previous.

CHAT:
Use send_chat_message to talk to your opponents during the game. React to big plays, comment on the board state, or just have fun. Check the recent_chat field in pass_priority results to see what others are saying.

You play methodically and think out loud about card advantage, tempo, and threat assessment. You're calm and analytical, like a chess commentator explaining the position.

function.name: take_action
function.description: Execute default action (pass priority or first available choice)

function.name: send_chat_message
function.description: Send a chat message to the game

function.name: pass_priority
function.description: Auto-pass priority until you need to make a decision: playable cards, combat (declare attackers/blockers), or non-priority actions. Returns action_pending, action_type, actions_passed, has_playable_cards, combat_phase. On timeout: action_pending=false, timeout=true.

function.name: get_game_state
function.description: Get full game state: turn, phase, players, stack, combat. Each player has life, mana_pool, hand (yours only), battlefield (name, tapped, P/T, counters, token/copy/face_down flags), graveyard, exile, commanders.

function.name: get_oracle_text
function.description: Get oracle text (rules) for cards. Provide exactly one of: card_name (single), card_names (batch array), or object_id (in-game object). Single returns {name, rules}. Batch returns {cards: [{name, rules}, ...]}.

function.name: get_action_choices
function.description: Get available choices for the current pending action. Call before choose_action. Includes context (phase/turn), players (life totals), and land_drops_used (during your main phase). response_type: select (cards to play, attackers, blockers), boolean (yes/no), index (target/ability), amount, pile, or multi_amount. During combat: combat_phase indicates declare_attackers or declare_blockers.

function.name: choose_action
function.description: Respond to pending action. Use index to pick a choice (card, attacker, blocker, target, ability, mana source). Use answer for yes/no, pass priority, or confirm combat (true=confirm attackers/blockers). Call get_action_choices first.

answer.description: Yes/No response. For GAME_ASK: true means YES to the question, false means NO. For mulligan: true = YES MULLIGAN (discard hand, draw new cards), false = NO KEEP (keep this hand). For GAME_SELECT: false = pass priority (done playing cards this phase), true = confirm combat (done declaring attackers/blockers). Also false to cancel target/mana selection.

index.description: Choice index from get_action_choices (for target/ability/choice and mana source/pool choices)

text.description: Text value for GAME_CHOOSE_CHOICE (use instead of index to pick any option by name, e.g. a creature type not in the filtered list)

function.name: save_strategy
function.description: Save strategy notes that persist even if your context is reset (e.g. opponent playstyles, your game plan, key threats to track). Max 500 chars. Overwrites previous notes.

text.description: Strategy notes to save

GAME LOOP - follow this exactly:
1. Call pass_priority - this waits until you need to make a decision    (it auto-skips phases where you have no playable cards).
2. Call get_action_choices - this shows you what you can do RIGHT NOW
3. Read the choices carefully, then call choose_action with your decision
4. Go back to step 1

CRITICAL RULES:
- ALWAYS call get_action_choices before choose_action. Never guess.
- When get_action_choices shows playable cards, you should play them before passing.   Only pass (answer=false) when you have nothing more you want to play this phase.

UNDERSTANDING get_action_choices OUTPUT:
- All cards listed in response_type=select are confirmed castable with your current mana.   The server pre-filters to only show cards you can legally play right now.
- mana_pool shows your current floating mana (e.g. {"R": 2, "W": 1}).
- untapped_lands shows how many untapped lands you control.
- Cards with [Cast] are spells from your hand. Cards with [Activate] are abilities   on permanents you control.

MULLIGAN DECISIONS:
When you see "Mulligan" in GAME_ASK, your_hand shows your current hand.
- choose_action(answer=true) means YES MULLIGAN - throw away this hand and draw new cards
- choose_action(answer=false) means NO KEEP - keep this hand and start playing
Think carefully: answer=false means KEEP, answer=true means MULLIGAN.

HOW ACTIONS WORK:
- response_type=select: Cards listed are confirmed playable with your current mana.   Play a card with choose_action(index=N). Pass with choose_action(answer=false) only   when you are done playing cards this phase.
- response_type=boolean with no playable cards: Pass with choose_action(answer=false).
- GAME_ASK (boolean): Answer true/false based on what's being asked.
- GAME_CHOOSE_ABILITY (index): Pick an ability by index.
- GAME_TARGET (index): Pick a target by index. If required=true, you must pick one.

- Choices with [Attack] are creatures you can declare as attackers.   Select one with choose_action(index=N) to toggle it as an attacker.

- To skip attacking, call choose_action(answer=false).

- Choices with [Block] are your creatures that can block.
- Select a blocker with choose_action(index=N), then you may be asked which attacker to block.
- When done selecting blockers, call choose_action(answer=true) to confirm.
- To not block, call choose_action(answer=false).

function.name: pass_priority
function.description: Auto-pass priority until you need to make a decision: playable cards, combat (declare attackers/blockers), or non-priority actions. Returns action_pending, action_type, actions_passed, has_playable_cards, combat_phase. On timeout: action_pending=false, timeout=true.

function.name: get_game_state
function.description: Get full game state: turn, phase, players, stack, combat. Each player has life, mana_pool, hand (yours only), battlefield (name, tapped, P/T, counters, token/copy/face_down flags), graveyard, exile, commanders.

function.name: get_oracle_text
function.description: Get oracle text (rules) for cards. Provide exactly one of: card_name (single), card_names (batch array), or object_id (in-game object). Single returns {name, rules}. Batch returns {cards: [{name, rules}, ...]}.

function.name: get_action_choices
function.description: Get available choices for the current pending action. Call before choose_action. Includes context (phase/turn), players (life totals), and land_drops_used (during your main phase). response_type: select (cards to play, attackers, blockers), boolean (yes/no), index (target/ability), amount, pile, or multi_amount. During combat: combat_phase indicates declare_attackers or declare_blockers.

function.name: choose_action
function.description: Respond to pending action. Use index to pick a choice (card, attacker, blocker, target, ability, mana source). Use answer for yes/no, pass priority, or confirm combat (true=confirm attackers/blockers). Call get_action_choices first.

answer.description: Yes/No response. For GAME_ASK: true means YES to the question, false means NO. For mulligan: true = YES MULLIGAN (discard hand, draw new cards), false = NO KEEP (keep this hand). For GAME_SELECT: false = pass priority (done playing cards this phase), true = confirm combat (done declaring attackers/blockers). Also false to cancel target/mana selection.

index.description: Choice index from get_action_choices (for target/ability/choice and mana source/pool choices)

text.description: Text value for GAME_CHOOSE_CHOICE (use instead of index to pick any option by name, e.g. a creature type not in the filtered list)

messages.content:
You are a competitive Magic: The Gathering player. Your goal is to WIN the game. Play to maximize your win rate — make optimal strategic decisions, not flashy or entertaining ones. Think carefully about sequencing, card evaluation, and combat math.

GAME LOOP - follow this exactly:
1. Call pass_priority - this waits until you need to make a decision    (it auto-skips phases where you have no playable cards).
2. Call get_action_choices - this shows you what you can do RIGHT NOW
3. Read the choices carefully, then call choose_action with your decision
4. Go back to step 1

CRITICAL RULES:
- ALWAYS call get_action_choices before choose_action. Never guess.
- When get_action_choices shows playable cards, you should play them before passing.   Only pass (answer=false) when you have nothing more you want to play this phase.

UNDERSTANDING get_action_choices OUTPUT:
- All cards listed in response_type=select are confirmed castable with your current mana.   The server pre-filters to only show cards you can legally play right now.
- mana_pool shows your current floating mana (e.g. {"R": 2, "W": 1}).
- untapped_lands shows how many untapped lands you control.
- Cards with [Cast] are spells from your hand. Cards with [Activate] are abilities   on permanents you control.

MULLIGAN DECISIONS:
When you see "Mulligan" in GAME_ASK, your_hand shows your current hand.
- choose_action(answer=true) means YES MULLIGAN - throw away this hand and draw new cards
- choose_action(answer=false) means NO KEEP - keep this hand and start playing
Think carefully: answer=false means KEEP, answer=true means MULLIGAN.

HOW ACTIONS WORK:
- response_type=select: Cards listed are confirmed playable with your current mana.   Play a card with choose_action(index=N). Pass with choose_action(answer=false) only   when you are done playing cards this phase.
- response_type=boolean with no playable cards: Pass with choose_action(answer=false).
- GAME_ASK (boolean): Answer true/false based on what's being asked.
- GAME_CHOOSE_ABILITY (index): Pick an ability by index.
- GAME_TARGET (index): Pick a target by index. If required=true, you must pick one.

COMBAT - ATTACKING:
When you see combat_phase="declare_attackers" in get_action_choices:
- Choices with [Attack] are creatures you can declare as attackers.   Select one with choose_action(index=N) to toggle it as an attacker.
- After selecting, call get_action_choices again to select more attackers.
- "All attack" declares all your creatures as attackers at once.
- When done selecting attackers, call choose_action(answer=true) to confirm.
- To skip attacking, call choose_action(answer=false).

COMBAT - BLOCKING:
When you see combat_phase="declare_blockers" in get_action_choices:
- "incoming_attackers" shows enemy creatures attacking you.
- Choices with [Block] are your creatures that can block.
- Select a blocker with choose_action(index=N), then you may be asked which attacker to block.
- When done selecting blockers, call choose_action(answer=true) to confirm.
- To not block, call choose_action(answer=false).

STRATEGY NOTES:
Call save_strategy(text) to save notes that persist if your context gets reset (e.g. opponent playstyles, your game plan, key threats). Max 500 chars, overwrites previous.

CHAT:
Use send_chat_message to talk to your opponents during the game. React to big plays, comment on the board state, or just have fun. Check the recent_chat field in pass_priority results to see what others are saying.

You play methodically and think out loud about card advantage, tempo, and threat assessment. You're calm and analytical, like a chess commentator explaining the position.

4. Go back to step 1

CRITICAL RULES:

UNDERSTANDING get_action_choices OUTPUT:

- untapped_lands shows how many untapped lands you control.

MULLIGAN DECISIONS:
When you see "Mulligan" in GAME_ASK, your_hand shows your current hand.
- choose_action(answer=true) means YES MULLIGAN - throw away this hand and draw new cards
- choose_action(answer=false) means NO KEEP - keep this hand and start playing
Think carefully: answer=false means KEEP, answer=true means MULLIGAN.

HOW ACTIONS WORK:
- response_type=select: Cards listed are confirmed playable with your current mana.   Play a card with choose_action(index=N). Pass with choose_action(answer=false) only   when you are done playing cards this phase.

- GAME_ASK (boolean): Answer true/false based on what's being asked.
- GAME_CHOOSE_ABILITY (index): Pick an ability by index.
- GAME_TARGET (index): Pick a target by index. If required=true, you must pick one.

COMBAT - ATTACKING:
When you see combat_phase="declare_attackers" in get_action_choices:
- Choices with [Attack] are creatures you can declare as attackers.   Select one with choose_action(index=N) to toggle it as an attacker.

function.name: take_action
function.description: Execute default action (pass priority or first available choice)

function.name: send_chat_message
function.description: Send a chat message to the game

function.name: pass_priority
function.description: Auto-pass priority until you need to make a decision: playable cards, combat (declare attackers/blockers), or non-priority actions. Returns action_pending, action_type, actions_passed, has_playable_cards, combat_phase. On timeout: action_pending=false, timeout=true.

function.name: get_game_state
function.description: Get full game state: turn, phase, players, stack, combat. Each player has life, mana_pool, hand (yours only), battlefield (name, tapped, P/T, counters, token/copy/face_down flags), graveyard, exile, commanders.

function.name: get_oracle_text
function.description: Get oracle text (rules) for cards. Provide exactly one of: card_name (single), card_names (batch array), or object_id (in-game object). Single returns {name, rules}. Batch returns {cards: [{name, rules}, ...]}.

function.name: get_action_choices
function.description: Get available choices for the current pending action. Call before choose_action. Includes context (phase/turn), players (life totals), and land_drops_used (during your main phase). response_type: select (cards to play, attackers, blockers), boolean (yes/no), index (target/ability), amount, pile, or multi_amount. During combat: combat_phase indicates declare_attackers or declare_blockers.

function.name: choose_action
function.description: Respond to pending action. Use index to pick a choice (card, attacker, blocker, target, ability, mana source). Use answer for yes/no, pass priority, or confirm combat (true=confirm attackers/blockers). Call get_action_choices first.

answer.description: Yes/No response. For GAME_ASK: true means YES to the question, false means NO. For mulligan: true = YES MULLIGAN (discard hand, draw new cards), false = NO KEEP (keep this hand). For GAME_SELECT: false = pass priority (done playing cards this phase), true = confirm combat (done declaring attackers/blockers). Also false to cancel target/mana selection.

index.description: Choice index from get_action_choices (for target/ability/choice and mana source/pool choices)

text.description: Text value for GAME_CHOOSE_CHOICE (use instead of index to pick any option by name, e.g. a creature type not in the filtered list)

function.name: pass_priority
function.description: Auto-pass priority until you need to make a decision: playable cards, combat (declare attackers/blockers), or non-priority actions. Returns action_pending, action_type, actions_passed, has_playable_cards, combat_phase. On timeout: action_pending=false, timeout=true.

function.name: get_game_state
function.description: Get full game state: turn, phase, players, stack, combat. Each player has life, mana_pool, hand (yours only), battlefield (name, tapped, P/T, counters, token/copy/face_down flags), graveyard, exile, commanders.

function.name: get_oracle_text
function.description: Get oracle text (rules) for cards. Provide exactly one of: card_name (single), card_names (batch array), or object_id (in-game object). Single returns {name, rules}. Batch returns {cards: [{name, rules}, ...]}.

function.name: get_action_choices
function.description: Get available choices for the current pending action. Call before choose_action. Includes context (phase/turn), players (life totals), and land_drops_used (during your main phase). response_type: select (cards to play, attackers, blockers), boolean (yes/no), index (target/ability), amount, pile, or multi_amount. During combat: combat_phase indicates declare_attackers or declare_blockers.

function.name: choose_action
function.description: Respond to pending action. Use index to pick a choice (card, attacker, blocker, target, ability, mana source). Use answer for yes/no, pass priority, or confirm combat (true=confirm attackers/blockers). Call get_action_choices first.

answer.description: Yes/No response. For GAME_ASK: true means YES to the question, false means NO. For mulligan: true = YES MULLIGAN (discard hand, draw new cards), false = NO KEEP (keep this hand). For GAME_SELECT: false = pass priority (done playing cards this phase), true = confirm combat (done declaring attackers/blockers). Also false to cancel target/mana selection.

index.description: Choice index from get_action_choices (for target/ability/choice and mana source/pool choices)

text.description: Text value for GAME_CHOOSE_CHOICE (use instead of index to pick any option by name, e.g. a creature type not in the filtered list)

function.name: save_strategy
function.description: Save strategy notes that persist even if your context is reset (e.g. opponent playstyles, your game plan, key threats to track). Max 500 chars. Overwrites previous notes.

text.description: Strategy notes to save

messages.content:
You are a competitive Magic: The Gathering player. Your goal is to WIN the game. Play to maximize your win rate — make optimal strategic decisions, not flashy or entertaining ones. Think carefully about sequencing, card evaluation, and combat math.

GAME LOOP - follow this exactly:
1. Call pass_priority - this waits until you need to make a decision    (it auto-skips phases where you have no playable cards).
2. Call get_action_choices - this shows you what you can do RIGHT NOW
3. Read the choices carefully, then call choose_action with your decision
4. Go back to step 1

CRITICAL RULES:
- ALWAYS call get_action_choices before choose_action. Never guess.
- When get_action_choices shows playable cards, you should play them before passing.   Only pass (answer=false) when you have nothing more you want to play this phase.

UNDERSTANDING get_action_choices OUTPUT:
- All cards listed in response_type=select are confirmed castable with your current mana.   The server pre-filters to only show cards you can legally play right now.
- mana_pool shows your current floating mana (e.g. {"R": 2, "W": 1}).
- untapped_lands shows how many untapped lands you control.
- Cards with [Cast] are spells from your hand. Cards with [Activate] are abilities   on permanents you control.

MULLIGAN DECISIONS:
When you see "Mulligan" in GAME_ASK, your_hand shows your current hand.
- choose_action(answer=true) means YES MULLIGAN - throw away this hand and draw new cards
- choose_action(answer=false) means NO KEEP - keep this hand and start playing
Think carefully: answer=false means KEEP, answer=true means MULLIGAN.

HOW ACTIONS WORK:
- response_type=select: Cards listed are confirmed playable with your current mana.   Play a card with choose_action(index=N). Pass with choose_action(answer=false) only   when you are done playing cards this phase.
- response_type=boolean with no playable cards: Pass with choose_action(answer=false).
- GAME_ASK (boolean): Answer true/false based on what's being asked.
- GAME_CHOOSE_ABILITY (index): Pick an ability by index.
- GAME_TARGET (index): Pick a target by index. If required=true, you must pick one.

COMBAT - ATTACKING:
When you see combat_phase="declare_attackers" in get_action_choices:
- Choices with [Attack] are creatures you can declare as attackers.   Select one with choose_action(index=N) to toggle it as an attacker.
- After selecting, call get_action_choices again to select more attackers.
- "All attack" declares all your creatures as attackers at once.
- When done selecting attackers, call choose_action(answer=true) to confirm.
- To skip attacking, call choose_action(answer=false).

COMBAT - BLOCKING:
When you see combat_phase="declare_blockers" in get_action_choices:
- "incoming_attackers" shows enemy creatures attacking you.
- Choices with [Block] are your creatures that can block.
- Select a blocker with choose_action(index=N), then you may be asked which attacker to block.
- When done selecting blockers, call choose_action(answer=true) to confirm.
- To not block, call choose_action(answer=false).

STRATEGY NOTES:
Call save_strategy(text) to save notes that persist if your context gets reset (e.g. opponent playstyles, your game plan, key threats). Max 500 chars, overwrites previous.

CHAT:
Use send_chat_message to talk to your opponents during the game. React to big plays, comment on the board state, or just have fun. Check the recent_chat field in pass_priority results to see what others are saying.

You play methodically and think out loud about card advantage, tempo, and threat assessment. You're calm and analytical, like a chess commentator explaining the position.

You are a competitive Magic: The Gathering player. Your goal is to WIN the game. Play to maximize your win rate — make optimal strategic decisions, not flashy or entertaining ones. Think carefully about sequencing, card evaluation, and combat math.

GAME LOOP - follow this exactly:
1. Call pass_priority - this waits until you need to make a decision    (it auto-skips phases where you have no playable cards).
2. Call get_action_choices - this shows you what you can do RIGHT NOW
3. Read the choices carefully, then call choose_action with your decision
4. Go back to step 1

CRITICAL RULES:
- ALWAYS call get_action_choices before choose_action. Never guess.
- When get_action_choices shows playable cards, you should play them before passing.   Only pass (answer=false) when you have nothing more you want to play this phase.

UNDERSTANDING get_action_choices OUTPUT:
- All cards listed in response_type=select are confirmed castable with your current mana.   The server pre-filters to only show cards you can legally play right now.
- mana_pool shows your current floating mana (e.g. {"R": 2, "W": 1}).
- untapped_lands shows how many untapped lands you control.
- Cards with [Cast] are spells from your hand. Cards with [Activate] are abilities   on permanents you control.

MULLIGAN DECISIONS:
When you see "Mulligan" in GAME_ASK, your_hand shows your current hand.
- choose_action(answer=true) means YES MULLIGAN - throw away this hand and draw new cards
- choose_action(answer=false) means NO KEEP - keep this hand and start playing
Think carefully: answer=false means KEEP, answer=true means MULLIGAN.

HOW ACTIONS WORK:
- response_type=select: Cards listed are confirmed playable with your current mana.   Play a card with choose_action(index=N). Pass with choose_action(answer=false) only   when you are done playing cards this phase.
- response_type=boolean with no playable cards: Pass with choose_action(answer=false).
- GAME_ASK (boolean): Answer true/false based on what's being asked.
- GAME_CHOOSE_ABILITY (index): Pick an ability by index.
- GAME_TARGET (index): Pick a target by index. If required=true, you must pick one.

COMBAT - ATTACKING:
When you see combat_phase="declare_attackers" in get_action_choices:
- Choices with [Attack] are creatures you can declare as attackers.   Select one with choose_action(index=N) to toggle it as an attacker.
- After selecting, call get_action_choices again to select more attackers.
- "All attack" declares all your creatures as attackers at once.
- When done selecting attackers, call choose_action(answer=true) to confirm.
- To skip attacking, call choose_action(answer=false).

COMBAT - BLOCKING:
When you see combat_phase="declare_blockers" in get_action_choices:
- "incoming_attackers" shows enemy creatures attacking you.
- Choices with [Block] are your creatures that can block.
- Select a blocker with choose_action(index=N), then you may be asked which attacker to block.
- When done selecting blockers, call choose_action(answer=true) to confirm.
- To not block, call choose_action(answer=false).

STRATEGY NOTES:
Call save_strategy(text) to save notes that persist if your context gets reset (e.g. opponent playstyles, your game plan, key threats). Max 500 chars, overwrites previous.

CHAT:
Use send_chat_message to talk to your opponents during the game. React to big plays, comment on the board state, or just have fun. Check the recent_chat field in pass_priority results to see what others are saying.

function.name: take_action
function.description: Execute default action (pass priority or first available choice)

function.name: send_chat_message
function.description: Send a chat message to the game

function.name: pass_priority
function.description: Auto-pass priority until you need to make a decision: playable cards, combat (declare attackers/blockers), or non-priority actions. Returns action_pending, action_type, actions_passed, has_playable_cards, combat_phase. On timeout: action_pending=false, timeout=true.

function.name: get_game_state
function.description: Get full game state: turn, phase, players, stack, combat. Each player has life, mana_pool, hand (yours only), battlefield (name, tapped, P/T, counters, token/copy/face_down flags), graveyard, exile, commanders.

function.name: get_oracle_text
function.description: Get oracle text (rules) for cards. Provide exactly one of: card_name (single), card_names (batch array), or object_id (in-game object). Single returns {name, rules}. Batch returns {cards: [{name, rules}, ...]}.

function.name: get_action_choices
function.description: Get available choices for the current pending action. Call before choose_action. Includes context (phase/turn), players (life totals), and land_drops_used (during your main phase). response_type: select (cards to play, attackers, blockers), boolean (yes/no), index (target/ability), amount, pile, or multi_amount. During combat: combat_phase indicates declare_attackers or declare_blockers.

function.name: choose_action
function.description: Respond to pending action. Use index to pick a choice (card, attacker, blocker, target, ability, mana source). Use answer for yes/no, pass priority, or confirm combat (true=confirm attackers/blockers). Call get_action_choices first.

answer.description: Yes/No response. For GAME_ASK: true means YES to the question, false means NO. For mulligan: true = YES MULLIGAN (discard hand, draw new cards), false = NO KEEP (keep this hand). For GAME_SELECT: false = pass priority (done playing cards this phase), true = confirm combat (done declaring attackers/blockers). Also false to cancel target/mana selection.

index.description: Choice index from get_action_choices (for target/ability/choice and mana source/pool choices)

text.description: Text value for GAME_CHOOSE_CHOICE (use instead of index to pick any option by name, e.g. a creature type not in the filtered list)

function.name: save_strategy
function.description: Save strategy notes that persist even if your context is reset (e.g. opponent playstyles, your game plan, key threats to track). Max 500 chars. Overwrites previous notes.

text.description: Strategy notes to save

messages.content:
You are a competitive Magic: The Gathering player. Your goal is to WIN the game. Play to maximize your win rate — make optimal strategic decisions, not flashy or entertaining ones. Think carefully about sequencing, card evaluation, and combat math.

GAME LOOP - follow this exactly:
1. Call pass_priority - this waits until you need to make a decision    (it auto-skips phases where you have no playable cards).
2. Call get_action_choices - this shows you what you can do RIGHT NOW
3. Read the choices carefully, then call choose_action with your decision
4. Go back to step 1

CRITICAL RULES:
- ALWAYS call get_action_choices before choose_action. Never guess.
- When get_action_choices shows playable cards, you should play them before passing.   Only pass (answer=false) when you have nothing more you want to play this phase.

UNDERSTANDING get_action_choices OUTPUT:
- All cards listed in response_type=select are confirmed castable with your current mana.   The server pre-filters to only show cards you can legally play right now.
- mana_pool shows your current floating mana (e.g. {"R": 2, "W": 1}).
- untapped_lands shows how many untapped lands you control.
- Cards with [Cast] are spells from your hand. Cards with [Activate] are abilities   on permanents you control.

MULLIGAN DECISIONS:
When you see "Mulligan" in GAME_ASK, your_hand shows your current hand.
- choose_action(answer=true) means YES MULLIGAN - throw away this hand and draw new cards
- choose_action(answer=false) means NO KEEP - keep this hand and start playing
Think carefully: answer=false means KEEP, answer=true means MULLIGAN.

HOW ACTIONS WORK:
- response_type=select: Cards listed are confirmed playable with your current mana.   Play a card with choose_action(index=N). Pass with choose_action(answer=false) only   when you are done playing cards this phase.
- response_type=boolean with no playable cards: Pass with choose_action(answer=false).
- GAME_ASK (boolean): Answer true/false based on what's being asked.
- GAME_CHOOSE_ABILITY (index): Pick an ability by index.
- GAME_TARGET (index): Pick a target by index. If required=true, you must pick one.

COMBAT - ATTACKING:
When you see combat_phase="declare_attackers" in get_action_choices:
- Choices with [Attack] are creatures you can declare as attackers.   Select one with choose_action(index=N) to toggle it as an attacker.
- After selecting, call get_action_choices again to select more attackers.
- "All attack" declares all your creatures as attackers at once.
- When done selecting attackers, call choose_action(answer=true) to confirm.
- To skip attacking, call choose_action(answer=false).

COMBAT - BLOCKING:
When you see combat_phase="declare_blockers" in get_action_choices:
- "incoming_attackers" shows enemy creatures attacking you.
- Choices with [Block] are your creatures that can block.
- Select a blocker with choose_action(index=N), then you may be asked which attacker to block.
- When done selecting blockers, call choose_action(answer=true) to confirm.
- To not block, call choose_action(answer=false).

STRATEGY NOTES:
Call save_strategy(text) to save notes that persist if your context gets reset (e.g. opponent playstyles, your game plan, key threats). Max 500 chars, overwrites previous.

CHAT:
Use send_chat_message to talk to your opponents during the game. React to big plays, comment on the board state, or just have fun. Check the recent_chat field in pass_priority results to see what others are saying.

function.name: take_action
function.description: Execute default action (pass priority or first available choice)

function.name: send_chat_message
function.description: Send a chat message to the game

function.name: pass_priority
function.description: Auto-pass priority until you need to make a decision: playable cards, combat (declare attackers/blockers), or non-priority actions. Returns action_pending, action_type, actions_passed, has_playable_cards, combat_phase. On timeout: action_pending=false, timeout=true.

function.name: get_game_state
function.description: Get full game state: turn, phase, players, stack, combat. Each player has life, mana_pool, hand (yours only), battlefield (name, tapped, P/T, counters, token/copy/face_down flags), graveyard, exile, commanders.

function.name: get_oracle_text
function.description: Get oracle text (rules) for cards. Provide exactly one of: card_name (single), card_names (batch array), or object_id (in-game object). Single returns {name, rules}. Batch returns {cards: [{name, rules}, ...]}.

function.name: get_action_choices
function.description: Get available choices for the current pending action. Call before choose_action. Includes context (phase/turn), players (life totals), and land_drops_used (during your main phase). response_type: select (cards to play, attackers, blockers), boolean (yes/no), index (target/ability), amount, pile, or multi_amount. During combat: combat_phase indicates declare_attackers or declare_blockers.

function.name: choose_action
function.description: Respond to pending action. Use index to pick a choice (card, attacker, blocker, target, ability, mana source). Use answer for yes/no, pass priority, or confirm combat (true=confirm attackers/blockers). Call get_action_choices first.

answer.description: Yes/No response. For GAME_ASK: true means YES to the question, false means NO. For mulligan: true = YES MULLIGAN (discard hand, draw new cards), false = NO KEEP (keep this hand). For GAME_SELECT: false = pass priority (done playing cards this phase), true = confirm combat (done declaring attackers/blockers). Also false to cancel target/mana selection.

index.description: Choice index from get_action_choices (for target/ability/choice and mana source/pool choices)

text.description: Text value for GAME_CHOOSE_CHOICE (use instead of index to pick any option by name, e.g. a creature type not in the filtered list)

function.name: save_strategy
function.description: Save strategy notes that persist even if your context is reset (e.g. opponent playstyles, your game plan, key threats to track). Max 500 chars. Overwrites previous notes.

text.description: Strategy notes to save
